usedFor: Elai builds the videos and Google Docs keeps the notes, so “Video Ready” can write an entry through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Video Ready” in Elai, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A finished video is worth logging, so the action adds a line to a chosen document tab.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab’s existing content, so check its mode before “Video Ready” runs it.
